nodes.label: Pre-pilot Controls, Correlation ID, Operational Event Append-only
nodes.rationale: PrePilotFeatureGate + AttachCorrelationId + append-only OperationalEvent let the platform record pilot readiness signals without mutating source transaction tables.

nodes.label: Development Roadmap — Digital Distribution Management Platform
Sanctum Stateless JWT Configuration
nodes.rationale: tymon/jwt-auth is stateless, so SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS is set empty; otherwise Sanctum injects CSRF validation into /api/* and login fails with 419 CSRF token mismatch.

nodes.label: Digital Distribution Management Platform — Business Idea
Distribution Network Owner (business positioning)
nodes.rationale: The platform should not compete as a normal marketplace; its value is a digital distribution network connecting brands with trusted retail outlets while providing sales intelligence and operational efficiency — the goal is to own the distribution network, not merely retail.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules (read node_modules/next/dist/docs)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes vs training data, so agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code; the block is re-added by next dev, so committing it keeps the tree clean.

nodes.label: Dummy Mode Jabodetabek Plan (12 tasks, 3 phases)
Determinism Seam Design (Option A: Zustand store + per-API guard)
nodes.rationale: toggle() takes no args and the only seam by which today reaches the factory is setDummyGenerator(fn), so tests and Phase C can pin a fixed date without touching Date.now() inside the factories — refresh must render byte-identical deterministic data, not just restore the flag.

nodes.label: Ephemeral Entities Principle (mutations never persisted)
nodes.rationale: Only the isDummy flag is persisted; dummy entities and mutations are in-memory and cleared on toggle OFF, so demo data can never leak into real state and OFF restores true backend behavior.

nodes.label: Zero-Network Invariant While Dummy ON
nodes.rationale: Every read and write call-site is guarded per API function so that while Dummy is ON no fetch reaches the backend — enabling fully offline demos with identical success UI.

nodes.label: Derived Aggregates Principle (no hardcoded numbers)
nodes.rationale: Aggregates must be derived from the transactions (counts/sums/groupings) and analytics generators must never return empty arrays, so charts show meaningful relational patterns instead of constants.

nodes.label: Dummy Mode Phase A — Foundation + Data
Guard Import Principle (never reimplement isDummy check locally)
nodes.rationale: Every call-site must import withDummyRead/commitIfCurrent/useDummyRefresh from dummy/guards.ts rather than reimplementing the isDummy check, so the guard behavior stays centralized and consistent across modules and pages.

nodes.label: Write Isolation Principle (no POST/PATCH while Dummy ON)
nodes.rationale: While Dummy is ON a write must never reach the backend; all POST/PATCH call-sites route to in-memory fake mutations with dummy-/negative IDs so real data can never be corrupted during a demo.
